claims.text: The dataset consists of more than 70,000 US English phone conversations, each averaging 11 minutes in duration.
The intent library used in the experiments comprises 313 intents, with each intent expressed using an average of 169 examples.
A sample dataset of 500 rescored intent annotations was used for evaluation, specifically in the cancellations and refunds domain.
